info.name: Surf One PG API
info.description:
Collection for Surf One Payment Gateway API - M-Pesa integration for WiFi access

AUTHENTICATION:
This collection uses HTTP Basic Auth for protected endpoints.
- Username: Email (e.g., john@example.com)
- Password: User password
- Set {{email}} and {{password}} environment variables before testing protected endpoints

PUBLIC ENDPOINTS (no auth required):
- GET /api/v1/packages
- POST /api/v1/users (registration)
- POST /api/v1/payments
- GET /api/v1/payments/{ref}

PROTECTED ENDPOINTS (Basic Auth required):
- All User endpoints (except Create/Register)
- All Subscription endpoints
- All Renewal endpoints

Retrieves a list of all active data packages available for purchase

Initiates a payment transaction for a selected data package. This triggers an M-Pesa STK push to the customer's phone.

**Request Parameters:**
- `phoneNumber` (required): Customer's Kenyan phone number in format +254XXXXXXXXX or 0XXXXXXXXX
- `packageCode` (required): The code of the data package to purchase

**Response:**
- `merchantReference`: Unique identifier for tracking this transaction
- `status`: Current status of the transaction (PENDING, RECEIVED, PROVISIONED, FAILED, EXPIRED)
- `message`: Human-readable status message

response.name: Accepted (STK Push Initiated)
Bad Gateway (STK Push Failed)

request.description:
Retrieves the current status of a payment transaction. This endpoint is polled by the captive portal every couple of seconds while waiting for the webhook confirmation.

**Path Parameters:**
- `merchantReference` (required): The transaction reference returned from the initiate payment endpoint

**Response:**
- `merchantReference`: Transaction identifier
- `status`: Current status (PENDING, RECEIVED, PROVISIONED, FAILED, EXPIRED)
- `radiusUsername`: WiFi username (provided when status is PROVISIONED)
- `radiusPassword`: WiFi password (provided when status is PROVISIONED)
- `message`: Status description

request.description:
Webhook endpoint that receives payment callbacks from KopoKopo after customers complete M-Pesa transactions.

**Headers:**
- `X-KopoKopo-Signature` (required): HMAC-SHA256 signature for request validation

**Body:**
- `id`: Event ID from KopoKopo
- `topic`: Event type (buygoods_transaction_received or incoming_payment)
- `created_at`: Timestamp when event occurred
- `data`: Transaction details including amount, reference, and sender info

**Note:** This endpoint validates the incoming request signature before processing to ensure authenticity.
